title: Next Retail Supplier Cyber Incident
description: Next warned that hackers gained access to limited data through a technology supplier. Customer personal data not compromised; information described as limited and benign.
impact: Supplier environment affected; company systems intact.

title: Samsung Securities Customer Data Exposure
description: Cyberattack exposed personal information of 8,241 customers including names, account numbers and driver's licence numbers from complaint form attachments.
impact: Personal and financial data of over 8,000 customers exposed.

title: Bybit Ethereum Cold Wallet Theft
description: North Korean Lazarus Group drained approximately $1.46 billion in ETH and derivatives from Bybit's Ethereum cold wallet via compromised Safe{Wallet} interface. Largest crypto theft on record at the time.
impact: Massive cryptocurrency theft; Bybit absorbed loss from reserves.

title: Change Healthcare Ransomware & Data Breach
description: Confirmation that the February 2024 ALPHV ransomware attack affected 192.7 million people — largest healthcare breach in US history. Exposed medical, insurance and billing data; disrupted claims nationwide.
impact: 192.7 million individuals' PHI exposed; massive payment disruption.

title: Jaguar Land Rover Cyberattack
description: Scattered Lapsus$ Hunters ransomware halted production at UK plants for weeks. Estimated £1.9–2.2 billion loss; major supply-chain impact.
impact: Production stoppage and huge financial losses.

title: Marks & Spencer Ransomware Attack
description: Scattered Spider attack disrupted operations and payments. Estimated losses £300–405 million; customer data stolen.
impact: Retail operational disruption and data theft.

title: Oracle E-Business Suite & Cloud Identity Breaches
description: Exploitation of Oracle EBS zero-days and earlier Cloud SSO systems affected hundreds of organizations; large-scale data exfiltration claimed.
impact: Supply-chain data theft and extortion.

title: F5 BIG-IP Source Code Theft
description: Nation-state actors maintained long-term access, stealing BIG-IP source code and vulnerability information.
impact: Elevated supply-chain risk for F5 customers.

title: DaVita Patient Data Breach
description: Ransomware accessed data of 2.7 million patients including SSNs, insurance and clinical records.
impact: Large healthcare PHI exposure.

title: SimonMed Imaging Cyberattack
description: January attack compromised 1.27 million patients and 212 GB of data.
impact: PHI of over a million patients exposed.

title: SK Telecom Subscriber Breaches
description: Incidents affected nearly 27 million subscribers with risks of SIM cloning and data theft.
impact: Mass telecom customer data exposure.

title: Qantas Customer Data Breach
description: Salesforce platform compromise led to data on ~5.7 million customers being stolen and later leaked.
impact: Airline customer PII exposure.

title: Asahi Group Ransomware
description: Ransomware disrupted industrial and logistics systems; data stolen.
impact: Operational disruption at major food/beverage group.

title: PowerSchool Student Data Breach
description: Exposed data of tens of millions of US K-12 students and teachers including SSNs and medical info.
impact: Massive student records exposure.

title: St. Paul MN Ransomware Attack
description: City systems taken offline; data accessed; service disruptions for weeks.
impact: Municipal disruption and data exposure.

title: Salesforce Third-Party Compromises
description: Compromises of apps integrated with Salesforce stole data from hundreds of organizations.
impact: Widespread CRM supply-chain data theft.

title: Coupang Data Breach
description: Personal data of nearly 34 million customers exposed.
impact: Massive e-commerce PII breach.

title: SBC Medical Group Data Breach
description: Unauthorized access extracted personal and treatment records of 1.62 million people.
impact: Healthcare customer and employee data exposure.

title: FBI NCIC Database Intrusion Investigation
description: FBI investigating apparent breach of National Crime Information Center law enforcement database.
impact: Potential exposure of sensitive criminal justice records.

title: West Virginia Legislature Cyber Incident
description: Cybersecurity incident (possible ransomware) took legislature systems and website offline.
impact: State legislative IT disruption.

title: Equinor & Skagerak Energi IT Attacks
description: Cyberattacks on IT systems at energy companies; operations unaffected; linked to Azure API Management vulnerability.
impact: IT disruption at energy producers.

title: Optimizely Experimentation Supply-Chain Attack
description: Malicious JavaScript injected into customer projects via vulnerability, affecting sites of 178 organizations including major media.
impact: Card skimming and crypto theft malware delivered via trusted scripts.

title: USDA Farm Payment Systems Incident
description: Security incident caused outages of farmer payment, loan and crop insurance systems.
impact: Disruption to US farm aid systems.
